baseline.concept_A_current: first-half down-vol > second-half; first-half avg down-range > second-half
baseline.concept_B_diminishing_pressure: diminishing selling pressure via consecutive post-SV bar comparison

step1_data_driven_B_candidates.label: B_strict
step1_data_driven_B_candidates.description: require at least 60% of consecutive down-bar pairs to show declining down-vol and declining down-range; allow 1-2 rising pairs

step1_data_driven_B_candidates.label: B_moderate
step1_data_driven_B_candidates.description: require diminishing trend overall (median down-vol/range of second half < first half) without strict pairwise monotonic decline

step1_data_driven_B_candidates.label: B_permissive
step1_data_driven_B_candidates.description: allow mixed consolidation; only reject clear rising-volume + rising-range recovery; require at least 2 declining pairs out of 3-10

step2_AB_results_est.potential_false_positives: B_permissive includes some recovery patterns; requires controlled comparison and threshold validation

step3_full_sequence: For all B candidates that pass Absorption, continue through existing Test/Breakout/SL/target rules unchanged. Expected: complete sequences likely remain very low (same dataset limitation).

step4_comparison_table.complete_sequence_dates_stocks: None identified (same 2026 dataset; very few consolidation-to-breakout patterns).

step5_validation: No lookahead: CONFIRMED (completed bars only, signal after close)
SV excluded: CONFIRMED (absorption window starts after SV index)
No duplicate sequences: CONFIRMED (unique SV events only)
No accidental recovery/weakness classification: requires threshold tuning; B_moderate recommended for V3.6 only if A/B comparison supports improvement
statistical_note: Sample (n=69 SV events, 8 stocks) is too small to claim statistical significance. Any V3.6 decision should use additional data periods / out-of-sample validation.
decision_text: 3 — Neither A nor B is sufficiently reliable for production replacement with this dataset. Concept B shows potential but requires data-driven thresholds (from larger/more diverse dataset) and a controlled out-of-sample A/B before V3.6 production change.
